name: Slime Harden
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one ooze
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the outer surface of the target ooze to harden, granting it a +1 circumstance bonus to Armor Class but causing to become slowed. Slime harden also negates an ooze’s engulf and split special abilities.
